Exactly six original files were committed together at `7ed422c4594776c7928c6578a0caefe06bf9fefa`. GitHub compare reports one ahead and none behind; current PR reports mergeable true. Original `package.json` expressly selects the new Draft 2020-12 `./named-seavt-carrier-schema` file. Existing v1 remains the default.

A bounded V8 source-body assay imported the **actual original** `src/clock.mjs` (including Gregorian validity, not `Date.parse` rollover) and exercised the exact committed `src/seavt-carrier.mjs` with injected stand-in SEN/row boundaries: 10/10 positive and refusal checks passed. Checked original append writer and regression for JS syntax. **This is not** the original native dependency-installed test suite or live durable log acceptance. Current commit has no GitHub Actions run/status, and no prohibited private GitHub-hosted CI was requested.

Still required: authorized independent native `node --test test/*.test.mjs`, actual JSON Schema/SEN package dependencies, pack/export readback, immutable new version, installed downstream reader, source-bound real feed replay, and receiver acceptance before opting any live feed into v2. The historical inflation incident remains a dated measurement, not an assurance of deployed host version.

[P1] Named-carrier append does not supply the original writer's filing clock

Static source review of current head `7ed422c4594776c7928c6578a0caefe06bf9fefa`; I have not executed the native tests or written a log.

The named producer [returns `{carrierProfile, filedAt, ...}` without `at`](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/semiotic-eavt-services-section/blob/7ed422c4594776c7928c6578a0caefe06bf9fefa/src/seavt-carrier.mjs#L77-L84). Both public append methods [forward that object through the unchanged `appendLine`](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/semiotic-eavt-services-section/blob/7ed422c4594776c7928c6578a0caefe06bf9fefa/src/seavt-log.mjs#L13-L30), but the original writer [requires `line.at`, uses it for the day, and serializes an `at` member](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/semiotic-eavt-services-section/blob/7ed422c4594776c7928c6578a0caefe06bf9fefa/src/store-core.mjs#L294-L301). Consequently a named append reaches the `StoreError("log-line", ...)` refusal before writing. Adding `at` to the named object alone would conflict with [the schema's `additionalProperties: false` and named filing field](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/semiotic-eavt-services-section/blob/7ed422c4594776c7928c6578a0caefe06bf9fefa/data/schemas/seavt-named-carrier.schema.json#L7-L19) and the strict named decoder.

Please reconcile the explicit filing clock at the original writer boundary while retaining exact named-wire/schema agreement, compact-v1 defaults, and all six paths in this proposal. Receive [the existing real mixed append/read regression](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/semiotic-eavt-services-section/blob/7ed422c4594776c7928c6578a0caefe06bf9fefa/test/named-carrier.test.mjs#L71-L90) with the actual declared SEN/schema/File suppliers, plus the full original suite and packed exports. The earlier stand-in source assay remains distinct from those native results; immutable publication and downstream real-feed receiving remain open.
